question: How should the goddess be visualized in meditation?
premises: Meditation on the goddess is prescribed.
She is seated on a full-blown lotus.
She is described as dwelling in the world.
inference: One should meditate on her as seated on a full-blown lotus and dwelling in the world.
uncertainties: The epithet bhava+gehinīm may also suggest association with Bhava (Shiva).
plain_english: One should meditate on her, seated on a full-blown lotus, dwelling in the world.
